title: Spring Pasta Primavera
description: A colorful and flavorful vegetarian pasta dish loaded with spring vegetables.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add garlic and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add zucchini, spring onions, and cherry tomatoes to the skillet. Cook until vegetables are tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Stir in vegetable broth and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and let sauce cook for 2-3 minutes.
Drain pasta and return it to the pot. Add sauce and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Serve hot, topped with parmesan and basil.
